subject: Class 700 in Thameslink livery
method: Side elevation and nose profile from the Thameslink diagram (rows and columns at 81.6/81.3 px/m: the cab car's 20.52 m and the 3.77 m roof); the face measured onto the shell through cameras solved from bodyside points (match.py surface) on 700142 and 700129 (EXIF focal lengths); colours raw from photos.

calibration.notes: cab car px 33 (nose tip, row 270) to 1708 = 20.52 m (published) -> 81.6 px/m; car 2 1765..3398 = 20.16 m -> 81.0 px/m; rail row 338.5, roof row 32 = 3.77 m -> 81.3 px/m

trace.heights: dia col 400: glass rows 97-178 (2.97-1.97 m), frames 92-183; doors rows 61-262 (3.41-0.94 m); orange cantrail line rows 47-49 (3.57 m); roof row 32 (3.77 m)
trace.cab.doors: dia row 120: cab door window 188-214 px (1.90-2.22 m), the door outline 183-219; doors 492-635 and 1148-1291 px (blue leaves with their frames)
trace.bogies: dia row 315: wheel centres 181/401 and 1359/1579 px -> bogies 3.16 and 17.59 m; wheelbase not measured (the drawing's 2.7 m is schematic): the old 2.2 m kept
trace.nose.profile: dia: leftmost body pixel per row 40-270 from the tip at px 33 (row 270, 0.84 m)
trace.livery.shapes: dia (trace.py): the white slashes on the light grey body at each car end and below the windows, and the first-class yellow strip at the cantrail on the cab car (3.65-13.1 m, 3.44-3.53 m); the cab car's 1.49-2.41 m white is the cab door surround
trace.livery: photos (700142, 700121): a very light grey body with white slashes, sky-blue door leaves, the yellow face, an orange line at the cantrail; hues from the diagram toned to the photos by eye, no clean neutral patch (glossy side): unmeasured
trace.face: Camera solved on p142 (700142, EXIF focal 2224 px) from the first window's corners and the four lamps (rms 7.4 px; held-out lamp 3.2 cm, window corner 10.8 cm), then each face feature measured onto the shell (match.py surface): yellow panel 1.16-1.93 m, +-0.93 m at its top; black mask 1.95-3.25 m; glass 2.29-3.10 m; pods 0.72-1.37 m out, 1.46-1.85 m; lamps: tail outboard (+-1.19 m, 1.74 m), headlamp inboard (+-0.99 m, 1.66 m); number centred at 1.72 m
trace.livery.branding: TL (the Thameslink wordmark, its own dark grey with the pink slash): on 700121 (p121, three-quarter) it is small lettering under the pair of windows between door 1 and door 2, nearer door 2, not the purple banner the diagram draws (that was an earlier livery). Read along the car between the pair's outer edges (8.04 and 13.015 m at px 755 and 690, no perspective correction): 10.56-12.40 m; up from the windows' foot (1.97 m at row 395, 65 px/m there): centred 1.69 m, 0.23 m tall (1.9 m long at the artwork's 8.2 aspect). Car 2 kept at the diagram's offset from the cab car's (0.43 m nearer its front): 11.07 m; unmeasured
trace.face.outlines: 700129 head-on (p129, brightened; Canon R50 at 39 mm), scaled across by the lamps (tails 1.179 m out at 404 px apart, heads 1.002 m at 335 px: 170 px/m) and up from the tail lamps' centre (1.71 m): the black mask is a trapezoid, +-1.10 m under the roof line (3.20 m) narrowing to +-0.89 m at its foot, which is the yellow's top (1.89-1.90 m), its lower corners sitting on the lamp pods so the black runs unbroken from the screen into the pods; the glass fills it to a few centimetres (+-1.04 m at 3.10 m, +-0.86 m at 1.97 m, the wipers' foot); the yellow a trapezoid too, +-0.88 m at its top to +-0.66 m at its foot (1.10 m); pods 0.72-1.35 m out, 1.44-1.87 m; white cheeks below the pods and the coupler's recess between them, +-0.62 m, from the yellow's foot to 0.42 m; number centred 1.69 m. Before (from p142's camera, which fails held-out at 11 cm): {"mask": {"half": 1.22, "lo": 1.95, "hi": 3.25, "r": 0.25}, "glass": {"half": 1.08, "lo": 2.29, "hi": 3.1, "r": 0.18}, "panel": {"half": 0.93, "lo": 1.16, "hi": 1.93, "r": 0.12}, "pods": {"inner": 0.72, "outer": 1.37, "lo": 1.46, "hi": 1.85, "r": 0.1}, "lower": {"half": 0.75, "lo": 0.5, "hi": 1.14}}; the face is drawn in metres of a 1.4 m half-width scaled to the body's width at each height (1.32 m at 3.2 m), so the top widths measured on the photo are drawn 6% wider: mask 1.165 m, glass 1.094 m; review of the overlay: the black runs up past the destination display to just under the orange line (3.54 m) and is nearly the full width of the cab there (drawn 1.36 m: about 1.27 m on the body at that height), tapering onto the pods (was 3.2 m and 1.165 m, which left a band of body colour over the screen)
trace.face.pods: review: measured on 700129 (brightened) at 171 px/m from the tail lamps' 404 px spacing, centre 1051.75 px, up from the tails at 1.71 m: each pod a slanted quadrilateral, its inner edge along the yellow's edge from 0.870 m at 1.804 m to 0.712 m at 1.437 m, its top 1.80-1.84 m, its outer end rounded at 1.32-1.345 m, its foot rising outward to 1.58 m; the red tail outboard (1.172 m, 1.704 m, r 0.09) and the white headlamp inboard (0.954 m, 1.637 m, r 0.072); first render (a crop): the lamps read as small dots in a black box: the pod is dark smoked glass over a red LED cluster and a chrome headlamp nearly filling it, so the lamps are drawn glazed (Face.lampStyle) at their measured size; second render: the lamps still read small against the photo's (their lenses nearly fill the pod's height): tail r 0.1, head r 0.085; third pass (a closeup): the lenses are big round units nearly the pod's full height, side by side: tail r 0.11, head r 0.09; the unlit tail a red lens over its LEDs (Face.glazedTail)
